purpose: Raw bounded 1270j TEC-only debugger trial and six-driver internal-NTC reads, 2026-10-09.

register_provenance.actual_internal: The ntc_coeff_pct_per_c read was redirected from 0x008A to 0x007F before Modbus transmit. Each returned internal B=3988 K.
register_provenance.tec_cal_baseline: The current_cal_pct read was redirected from LD 0x0088 to TEC 0x007E.
register_provenance.final_tec_cal_read: Same redirection, final actual 100%, raw response 02 27 10.
register_provenance.other_queries: Normal responses except write-trigger queries, which fail read validation after a verified FC16 write ACK.

trial_method: Temporary breakpoints changed an encoded Modbus request while the existing laser I/O and interface mutexes were held. No source instrumentation, LD START/current writes, NTC coefficient writes, reset, reflash or explicit SAVE. TEC START required the same DENY_INTERLOCK prerequisite as normal profile preparation; original permission restored.
measurement_limits: Controller temperature readbacks, no independent physical temperature/current reference. Short plateaus, last three samples summarized. TEC current resolution 100 mA and voltage 0.1 V. Controller internals remain unconfirmed.
restoration: All six LD/TEC states, digital targets, PID/current limits, LD calibration and PCB settings match baseline; TEC calibration 100% independently read back. Bank/heater policy unchanged, no reboot. User debugger session left running with original five breakpoints.
